note: Container-operation and browser walkthrough by an agent, not a human operator study. Commands ran against disposable Compose projects owned by this walkthrough, built from no new images: the app and engine images are the ones lab.mjs built from the pinned commit, tagged for this project. Secrets, cookies, API keys, mail bodies and links are not recorded; command output is reduced to exit codes and selected sanitized lines.

steps.action: Check that the app reads the client address from X-Forwarded-For through the same-host Caddy proxy
steps.expected: With TRUSTED_PROXIES=127.0.0.1,::1 and Caddy on the host, the app records the client's address (here the loopback address the client used to reach Caddy), not the proxy's, and a client-sent X-Forwarded-For is replaced.
steps.actual: Check did not pass: Sign-in through Caddy connecting on 127.0.0.1 answered 200 and the session row holds ip_address 192.168.96.1; connecting on ::1 answered 200 with 192.168.96.1; with a client-sent X-Forwarded-For 203.0.113.9 it answered 200 with 192.168.96.1. 192.168.96.1 is the gateway of the installation's backend network, which is the source address Docker's published port gives every host-side connection.

steps.action: Reviewer diagnosis (not a guide step): set TRUSTED_PROXIES to the backend network gateway the app actually sees, recreate, and repeat the three sign-ins
steps.expected: If the gateway is the listed address, the app records each client's own address and Caddy's replacement of a client-sent X-Forwarded-For.
steps.actual: Check did not pass: With TRUSTED_PROXIES=192.168.96.1: via 127.0.0.1 ip_address 127.0.0.1; via ::1 0000:0000:0000:0000:0000:0000:0000:0000; with client-sent X-Forwarded-For 203.0.113.9 127.0.0.1.

steps.action: Reviewer diagnosis (not a guide step): set TRUSTED_PROXIES to the backend network gateway the app actually sees, recreate, and repeat the three sign-ins
steps.expected: If the gateway is the listed address, the app records each client's own address and Caddy's replacement of a client-sent X-Forwarded-For.
steps.actual: With TRUSTED_PROXIES=192.168.96.1: via 127.0.0.1 ip_address 127.0.0.1; via ::1 0000:0000:0000:0000:0000:0000:0000:0000; with client-sent X-Forwarded-For 203.0.113.9 127.0.0.1. (better-auth stores an IPv6 client by its /64 prefix, so ::1 appears as zeros.) So Caddy does replace a client-sent X-Forwarded-For, and the app believes it only when TRUSTED_PROXIES names the Docker network gateway, which is where host-side connections to the published port arrive from. The guide's 127.0.0.1,::1 never matches under the standard Compose file. TRUSTED_PROXIES was set back to 127.0.0.1,::1 and the app recreated.

steps.action: docker compose port app 3000, then APP_BIND=0.0.0.0 and back, and a direct request on the LAN and Tailscale addresses
steps.expected: The standard Compose file publishes on 127.0.0.1:PORT; APP_BIND=0.0.0.0 changes it to all addresses; removing APP_BIND and recreating returns to 127.0.0.1; with the default the port is unreachable on other host addresses.
steps.actual: docker compose port app 3000 printed 127.0.0.1:25710. /readyz on http://192.168.0.59:25710 and http://100.68.96.37:25710 got no connection (curl code 000, 000). With APP_BIND=0.0.0.0 and up, it printed 0.0.0.0:25710 and the LAN address answered 200. After removing APP_BIND and up again it printed 127.0.0.1:25710 and the LAN address got no connection (000).

steps.action: An earlier edition's compose.private.yml with ports: !override stays in COMPOSE_FILE: read the resulting port mapping

steps.actual: With compose.private.yml added to the file list, PORT=25710 in .env and APP_BIND=0.0.0.0 in the shell, the resolved app ports were [{"mode":"ingress","host_ip":"127.0.0.1","target":3000,"published":"3000","protocol":"tcp"}] (only the port list was read from config --format json; nothing else was printed). The recovery command under the wrong key exited 0; after the correct key was back, the saved upload limit and S3 reader were gone and the start log still reported advanced_settings as unreadable until a new save replaced it.
